world.title: West Asia war LIVE: Trump says will demand conflict compensation from Iran
world.summary: Oil prices have risen significantly, gaining around 10% over the past week, amid concerns over the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz due to the ongoing Iran-Israel conflict. This surge has heightened inflation fears and increased speculation regarding a potential U.S. interest rate hike this year. Former President Trump announced intentions to demand compensation from Iran for the conflict.

world.title: US-Iran war Highlights: Iran says service fees should be charged for ships using Strait of Hormuz
world.summary: Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesperson, Esmaeil Baghaei, stated that service fees should be implemented for ships using the Strait of Hormuz. He noted that this topic is not currently a focal point in negotiations between Iran and Oman. Meanwhile, US President Donald Trump indicated a preference for increasing economic pressure on Iran rather than initiating new military actions.

world.title: Who is Jayme Franklin, the woman seen behind Trump at Oval Office vaccine executive order signing?
world.summary: Jayme Franklin was present during President Donald Trump's signing of an executive order regarding childhood vaccines in the Oval Office. The order proposes changes to vaccine recommendations, specifically splitting the combined measles, mumps, and rubella (MMR) vaccine into separate shots. Following the event, Franklin shared her experience on X, highlighting her attendance at the White House for the signing.

business.title: Worried about Parag Parikh Flexicap? Here are your options
business.summary: Content creators frequently discuss Parag Parikh Flexicap due to its appeal to both unitholders and potential investors. This interest prompts various opinions and analyses. To navigate the information landscape effectively, it is suggested that individuals refrain from consuming financial content that may not provide valuable insights. Staying informed through reliable sources is crucial for making sound investment decisions.

business.title: 4 mid-cap hotel stocks trade 28%-46% cheaper than Taj. What is the market missing?
business.summary: Mid-cap hotel stocks have seen significant growth in net sales and profits, benefiting from a surge in domestic leisure travel during the June 2026 quarter. Despite this, these stocks are trading at a discount of 28% to 46% compared to industry leader The Indian Hotels Company. Foreign tourist arrivals have declined, impacting overall hotel performance.

business.title: Apple Reportedly Testing Controversial Chinese Chips as Memory Supply Crunch Intensifies
business.summary: Apple is reportedly testing memory chips from Chinese supplier CXMT, which the Trump Administration has labeled a military company. This development comes amid a growing supply crunch for memory components. Early discussions between Apple and CXMT suggest potential integration of these chips into certain Apple products, as the company seeks to address ongoing supply chain challenges.

technology.title: 5 years later, Windows 10 refuses to die, and Microsoft just can't push holdouts to Windows 11
technology.summary: Windows 11 was released in 2021, but five years later, Microsoft acknowledges that Windows 10 remains popular among users. Many holdouts continue to prefer Windows 10, viewing it as stable and reliable. Despite efforts to encourage upgrades, Microsoft seems to accept that a significant number of users may never transition to Windows 11.

technology.title: Take-Two CEO says GTA 6 Ultimate Edition leads pre-order sales, despite $100 price
technology.summary: Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick announced that the $100 GTA 6 Ultimate Edition is leading in pre-order sales, despite its high price. He emphasized that current interest may not necessarily indicate future sales performance. Zelnick's comments were made during a CNBC interview, where he refrained from disclosing specific sales figures but confirmed the edition's popularity ahead of its release.

technology.title: KAZ 2026 review: Play it beKAZ you can!
technology.summary: KAZ is a grid-based game designed to challenge players' reflexes, reminiscent of classic arcade games. The game emphasizes rhythm and instinctive responses, highlighting its connection to the evolution of video gaming. Players may find it tests their skills in a way that feels like an extreme sport, reflecting the intense engagement required in rhythm-based gaming experiences.

sports.title: Sourav Ganguly, wife Dona receive death threats; Kolkata Police begin probe
sports.summary: Former Indian cricket captain Sourav Ganguly has reported receiving multiple threatening letters, including one that allegedly threatened the lives of him and his wife, Dona. Following these incidents, he approached the Kolkata Police, who have initiated an investigation into the matter. The threats have raised concerns for the safety of Ganguly and his family amid ongoing inquiries.

sports.title: Caruana Scores 1st Win In Sinquefield Cup; Tan, Divya, Lee Lead Cairns Cup
sports.summary: GM Fabiano Caruana achieved his first victory in the 2026 Sinquefield Cup, defeating GM Jorden van Foreest and taking sole lead after round one. In the 2026 Cairns Cup, GM Tan Zhongyi, GM Divya Deshmukh, and IM Alice Lee each secured wins. All other matches in the Sinquefield Cup concluded in draws, highlighting a competitive round.

sports.title: 'Difficult assignment': PCB advised to 'keep away' Babar Azam from English media on England tour
sports.summary: Former Pakistan captain Rashid Latif has advised the Pakistan Cricket Board (PCB) to restrict Babar Azam's interactions with the English media during the upcoming three-Test tour of England. Latif expressed concerns that Babar might face intense scrutiny, which could affect his performance. The PCB is urged to consider this recommendation to protect the team's captain during the tour.

health.title: Drug discovery: Watching cancer cells live could open new frontiers
health.summary: Researchers are investigating technologies to observe living cancer cells in real time, aiming to enhance understanding of cancer behavior and improve drug discovery. This approach could address the challenges posed by cancer cells' evolution, adaptation, and treatment resistance. Experts believe that real-time observation may represent a significant advancement in biomedical research, particularly in the field of oncology.

health.title: Hey, Great News! Scientists Used AI to Create Viruses
health.summary: Stanford scientists have utilized artificial intelligence to create an artificial virus, raising concerns about potential gain-of-function research. The development highlights the evolving capabilities of AI, which have recently included advanced tasks such as hacking. The implications of this research, particularly regarding testing virulence in humans, are significant and warrant careful consideration in the context of bioethics and safety.

health.title: Louisiana reports 5 deaths from 'flesh-eating' bacteria found in oysters and swimming water: How to reduce your risk of a Vibrio vulnificus infection.
health.summary: Louisiana health officials report five deaths from the flesh-eating bacterium Vibrio vulnificus, part of a total of seven fatalities in Florida and Louisiana this year. Nine cases have been identified in Louisiana. Residents and beachgoers are advised to take precautions to reduce the risk of infection, particularly when consuming oysters or swimming in contaminated waters.

science.title: KAIST lines up gas atoms to pull gas mixtures apart
science.summary: A South Korean research team has demonstrated that gas atoms trapped in a porous solid can align in a regular pattern, similar to crystalline structures, rather than scattering randomly. This finding, currently validated through computer simulations, suggests a novel approach to material design, potentially enhancing the separation of gas mixtures. Further research may explore practical applications of this phenomenon.

science.title: Why the South Asian monsoon behaves like two systems
science.summary: The South Asian monsoon operates as two distinct systems influenced by southern Africa's weather patterns. Rainfall in India correlates with Northern Hemisphere summer sunlight, while the Arabian Sea's conditions are affected by cold water upwelling along its coast. This divergence weakens the winds that typically sustain the monsoon, resulting in a split between the two regions' climatic behaviors.

science.title: Anil Menon Completes His First ISS Spacewalk
science.summary: NASA astronaut Anil Menon completed his first spacewalk alongside Jessica Meir, lasting six hours. The mission focused on preparing the International Space Station (ISS) for new solar arrays. This significant achievement marks Menon's initial venture outside the ISS, contributing to ongoing efforts to enhance the station's capabilities. The spacewalk reflects NASA's continued commitment to space exploration and technology advancement.

entertainment.title: 'Jana Nayagan' box office collection day 19: Vijay and Pooja Hegde starrer takes a lead over Suriya's 'Karuppu,' earns Rs 320 crore
entertainment.summary: Vijay and Pooja Hegde's film 'Jana Nayagan' has grossed Rs 320 crore at the box office after 19 days. As it enters its third week, the film experienced a rise during the third weekend but faced a typical slowdown on Monday. It currently leads over Suriya's 'Karuppu' in box office earnings.

entertainment.title: Brad Pitt talks suicidal thoughts amid 'family stuff', says he's no longer sober
entertainment.summary: Actor Brad Pitt has revealed he is no longer sober and experienced brief suicidal thoughts linked to "family stuff." He discussed his mental health and struggles with alcoholism, connecting these issues to the aftermath of his split from Angelina Jolie. Pitt's comments highlight the ongoing challenges he faces in navigating personal relationships and maintaining his sobriety.

entertainment.title: Cancer Horoscope Today: August 11, 2026
entertainment.summary: Cancer individuals are encouraged to embrace change and avoid clinging to outdated habits. The current phase invites introspection, prompting the question of what they wish to create or build in their lives. New beginnings require a willingness to explore fresh opportunities and perspectives, suggesting that now is the time for growth and transformation in various aspects of life.
